item.title: Investors Bet on a Hair Loss Treatment Boom
item.description: [Bloomberg] Drugmakers are developing a new generation of hair loss treatments, including lotions, pills and longer-lasting injections, targeting a US market where tens of millions of men and women experience pattern hair loss. Joining Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz on Bloomberg This Weekend is Bloomberg News Equities Reporter Avalon Pernell says some treatments could seek approval and reach the market as soon as 2027, drawing investor interest in companies hoping to tap consumers already willing to spend heavily on hair restoration. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Shein’s $100 Billion Valuation Falls to $26 Billion

Bloomberg News Consumer Finance Reporter Lisa Du is on Bloomberg This Weekend with hosts Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz and says the fast-fashion giant is pitching investors on expanding beyond its core brand by acquiring or partnering with other labels, even as geopolitical, regulatory and reputational risks weigh on its growth story. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Venezuela Oil Deal Raises Questions Over US Role
item.description: [Bloomberg] The Trump administration’s deal giving a US-led venture access to 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil could reshape the countries’ economic relationship, but questions remain over its political durability and whether it will provoke a backlash inside Venezuela. Former Deputy National Secuirty Advisor for Middle East Affairs and the Heritage Foundation's Victoria Coates is on Bloomberg This Weekend and argues the agreement could encourage US investment and restore Venezuela’s energy sector, but says economic development must ultimately be accompanied by political liberalization and self-determination. item.title: NASA’s Roman Telescope Takes Aim at Cosmic Mysteries
item.description: [Bloomberg] NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy on a mission to study dark energy, dark matter and planets beyond our solar system. Roman is headed about 1 million miles from Earth to Lagrange point 2, where its wide field of view will allow scientists to survey billions of galaxies far faster than the Hubble telescope. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend to watch the launch with hosts Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz is Space Network Co-Founder and COO Ross Hamilton to discuss the telescope's mission. (Source: Bloomberg)
